svg.title: FinAware — System Architecture
svg.text: What runs where, and which part talks to which. Ports are the local defaults (npm run dev:stack:ml); in Docker and Kubernetes the same parts run as separate containers — see diagram 03.
Services — Express on Node.js, one process each
Shared code inside the web app — lib/
Runs inside the pages and API routes below; not a separate service.
• Score Coach, Debt Review Check and Case Summary read the
• Help triage: keywords at once; OpenAI may refine the advisor it
• Case Summary: OpenAI may reword it — the figures stay FinAware's

Debt Review Check · Case Summary · Check a Loan Offer · About the
Each page asks the services for its data before the HTML is sent.
Called by the browser with fetch() and JSON.
Each checks the session cookie (401 without it), then forwards the request
OpenAI Responses API — outside FinAware, optional
Asked only when OPENAI_API_KEY is set (model gpt-4.1-mini). Used for wording only: the rehab plan and dashboard tips,
the help-advisor suggestion and the Case Summary.
After a 401 or out-of-credit reply it is not asked again for 10 minutes; the calculated text is used.
Signing in needs only an SA ID or passport
number — there is no password. The session
is a cookie that holds the user id.

Rehab plan and the dashboard's AI tips — OpenAI when available, otherwise calculated.
Reads Users, Debts · writes an AI_Recommendations snapshot
Log in; Join creates a simulated person from the ID number; FICA verification.
Reads/writes Users; Join also creates Credit_Profile, Debts, Payment_History, Legal_Records
Metrics, financial age, risk factors and the 6-month score projection.
Personal details and the PDF download password.
Add and update debts; keeps credit totals current; a garnishee adds a legal record.
Saves a help request and returns the advisor's WhatsApp link.
